chunks: Mas‘adah narrated from al-Sadiq عليه السلام that he said:
"Cursed, cursed is wealth that is not purified by zakat."

key_terms.مَالٌ: wealth or property subject to financial obligation
key_terms.مَسْعَدَةُ: Mas‘adah, the narrator transmitting this report
key_terms.مَلْعُونٌ: accursed; deprived of divine blessing and mercy
key_terms.يُزَكَّى: is purified, meaning zakat is paid from it

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about wealth on which zakat is not paid?
ai.summary: This hadith strongly condemns wealth from which zakat is not paid. It emphasizes that zakat purifies wealth and that withholding it brings blame and divine curse.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1586 - Mas'adah reported from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) that he said:
"Cursed, cursed is the wealth that is not purified by Zakat."
